owis.englishMeaning: The thoughtlessness of parabrahman is beyond the `many' thoughts. That is unbro- ken, blotless/nirmal, still/nishchal and unmodified/nirvikar.

owis.original: परब्रह्मास कांहींच तुळेना । हा येक मुख्य जिनसाना । दुसरा जिनस नाना कल्पना । मूळमाया ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म हाच या विश्र्वरचनेमधील मुख्य जिन्नस आहे. त्याच्याबरोबर दुसर्‍या कशाचीही तुलना करतां येत नाहीं. अनेक कल्पनांनी भरलेली मूळमाया हा दुसरा जिन्नस आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' cannot be compared to parabrahman and so there are these four objects (see 20.4.30; step by step rise up higher to understand the origin of this `all'). That thoughtless One (ie. mula purush) is the most superior `object'. And mula maya is this other `object' and then there are the `many' objects and concepts.

owis.original: नाना सूक्ष्मरुप । सूक्ष्म आणी कर्दमरुप । मुळींच्या संकल्पाचा आरोप । मूळमाया ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमायेची अनेक सूक्ष्मरुपें आहेत. ती अतिशय सूक्ष्म असून मिश्रणमय आहे. निर्भेळ नाहीं. परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं जें मूळ स्फूरण झालें, त्याच्यावर जो आरोप करतात, त्यास मूळमाया म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' objects and there brahman's form. This means brahman and form. This form is the planting of the root and this is the original desire and this is mula maya.

owis.original: हरिसंकल्प मुळींचा । आत्माराम सकळांचा । संकेत नामाभिधानाचा । येणें प्रकारें ॥ ६॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या मूळच्या संकल्पाला हरिसंकेत असें म्हणतात. सर्वांच्या अंतर्यामीं वास करणारा आत्माराम अथवा अंतरात्मा तो हाच होय. त्याला जी नांवें दिलेली आहेत त्याचे संकेत पुढीलप्रमाणें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this original desire of hari at the root then, that atmaram appears as this `all'. Then that thoughtless Self has been assigned this `name' (or `I am').

owis.original: निश्र्चळीं चंचळ चेतलें । म्हणौनि चैतन्य बोलिलें । गुणसमानत्वें जालें । गुणसाम्य ऐसें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निश्र्चल ब्रह्मामध्यें चैतन्य जागें झालें म्हणून त्यास चैतन्य म्हणतात. तेथें गुणांचे प्रमाण सम किंवा सारखें असतें म्हणून त्यास गुणसाम्य म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In the stillness, a movement was kindled and this is chaitanya or the `speech'. `Here' there is a balancing of the gunas and such gets called the balanced gunas.

owis.original: अर्धनारीनटेश्र्वर । तोचि शडगुणैश्र्वर । प्रकृतिपुरुषाचा विचार । शिवशक्ती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अर्धनारीनटेश्र्वर व षडगुणेश्वर तोच आहे. शिवशक्ति आणि प्रकृतिपुरुषाचा विचारही तोच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that brahman has become *ardhanari-nateshwar or *shad-guneshwara or it is said that the thoughtless has become prakruti/purush or shiva/shakti. *(Half male/fe- male Lord and *Lord with the six qualities)

owis.original: शुद्धसत्वगुणाची मांडणी । अर्धमात्रा गुणक्षोभिणी । पुढें तिही गुणांची करणी । प्रगट जाली ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शुद्धसत्व गुणाची कल्पना, अर्धमात्रा असलेली गुणक्षोभिणी, तिच्यामधून पुढें प्रगट होणारे सत्व, रज व तम हे तीन गुण, मूळमायेची नांवें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is expansion out of this pure sattva guna then, this half-vowel of aum (ie. beyond the three states of a, u, m) is this gunakshobhini (agitation of the gunas; guna maya) and ahead this manifests as the doings of the three gunas.

owis.original: मन माया अंतरात्मा । चौदा जिनसांची सीमा । विद्यमान ज्ञानात्मा । इतुके ठाइं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन, माया, अंतरात्माअसें मायेच्या नांवाचें एकंदर चौदा प्रकार आहेत. सदैव अस्तित्वांत असणारा तो ज्ञानात्मा अथवा आदिसंकल्प इतक्या प्रकारानें प्रत्ययास येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: All this is mind, it is maya and that antar-atma. These fourteen names are this other `object' (of mula maya) and that knowing atma (ie. antar-atma) is the possessor of this. This much is His place.

owis.original: ऐसा दुसरा जिनस । अभिधानें चतुर्दश । आतां तिसरा जिनस । पंचमाहाभूतें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चौदा नावांचा हा दुसरा जिन्नस आहे. पंचमहाभूतें हा तिसरा जिन्नस होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is second object of these four objects and here it has been assigned fourteen names. Now the third object is the five great elements (from the tamo guna comes the five great elements).

owis.original: येथें पाहातां जाणीव थोडी । आदिअंत हे रोकडी । खाणी निरोपिल्या तांतडी । तो चौथा जिनस ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचमहाभूतांमध्यें जाणीवेचा अंश कमी प्रमाणांत आढळतो. परंतु त्यांच्या आधी व नंतर म्हणजे शेवटी जाणिवेचे अस्तित्व प्रत्यक्ष दिसते. आधीं मूळमायेमध्यें जाणीव असते. आणि नंतर चार खाणींमध्यें जाणीव दिसतें. म्हणून पंचभूतांच्या आदिअंती जाणीव असते. पूर्वी चात खाणी म्हणून घाईघाईनें सांगितलें तो चौथा जिन्नस होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Few understand this knowing `here' (ie. second object) and from the beginning to the end, that thoughtless (ie. first object) is within this ever present `experience' `here'. The four sources of birth are a hurried discourse and then that brahman is the fourth object (ie. a jiva).

owis.original: च्यारी खाणी अनंत प्राणी । जाणीवेची जाली दाटणी । च्यारी जिनस येथुनी । संपूर्ण जाले ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चार खाणी अनंत प्राणी आहेत. त्या प्राण्यांच्या अंतर्यामीं जाणिवेची जणूं काय गर्दी झाली आहे. त्यांच्या ठिकाणीं पुष्कळच जाणीव आढळते. असो. असे हे विश्र्वरचनेचे चार जिन्नस सांगितलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are these four sources of birth then, that endless paramatma is in the prana. They appear due to the `thickening' (ie. objectification) of this knowledge. But because of these four objects that have come from within maya, parabrahman can be understood. (Even this first object, that thoughtless purush, has come due to the appearance of maya; otherwise there was only parabrahman)

owis.original: बीज थोडें पेरिजेतें । पुढें त्याचें उदंड होतें । तैसें जालें आत्मयातें । खाणी वाणी प्रगटतां ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण थोडें बीज पेरतों. पण त्यापासून पुढें उदंड धान्य प्राप्त होते. चार खाणींमधील अनंत प्राण्यांमध्यें प्रगट होतांना अंतरात्म्याची स्थिति या बीजासारखी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as this `all' that is sown by the very few becomes that vast paramatma after- wards. So too, to that atma there comes the manifestation of the four sources of birth and the four speeches.

owis.original: ऐसी सत्ता प्रबळली । थोडे सत्तेची उदंड जाली । मनुष्यवेषें सृष्टी भोगिली । नाना प्रकारें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सत्तेची वाढ झाली. मूळच्या थोड्या सत्तेचा सपाटून विस्तार झाला. अखेर मनुष्यदेहामध्यें ती सत्ता सृष्टीचा अनेक प्रकारे भोग घेते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, His power expanded into this gross existence and only to the few has there come that paramatma of this power. And through the guise of a man in the gross world, that One enjoys and suffers the ways of the `many'.

owis.original: प्राणी मारुन स्वापद पळे । वरकड त्यास काये कळे । नाना भोग तो निवळे । मनुष्यदेहीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा हिंस्त्र पशु दुसर्‍याला मारुन पळून जातो. त्याला यापेक्षां अधिक कांहीं कळत नाहीं. पण अनेक प्रकारचे भोग भोगण्यांत माणूस मोठा पटाईत आहे. उदा. पशु मारुन त्याच्या मांसाचे अनेक प्रकार करुन खाण्याचे ज्ञान त्याला आहे. इतर प्राण्यांना नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In the prana, the beast kills and runs away. How can this and those like it, under- stand that paramatma? In the human body, there are the `many' enjoyments and that pure atma.

owis.original: नाना शब्द नाना स्पर्श । नाना रुप नाना रस । नाना गंध हे विशेष । नरदेह जाणे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द, स्पर्श, रुप, रस आणि गंध यांचे नाना प्रकार माणूस विशेष रीतीनें जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' words and the `many' forms of touch; when there are the `many' shapes, the `many' tastes and the `many' smells then, that pure knowledge is knowing a human body.

owis.original: अमोल्य रत्नें नाना वस्त्रें । नाना यानें नाना शस्त्रें । नाना विद्या कळा शास्त्रें । नरदेह जाणे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारची अमोल रत्नें, वस्त्रें वाहनें, शस्त्रें, नाना तर्‍हेच्या विद्या, कला, शास्त्रें माणसालाच माहित आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' priceless jewels and the `many' guises; when there are the `many' modes of transport and the `many' skills; when there are the `many' learnings and the `many' arts and shasthras then, that pure knowledge is knowing a human body.

owis.original: पृथ्वी सत्तेनें व्यापिली । स्थळोस्थळीं अटोपिली । नाना विद्या कळा केली । नाना धारणा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतरात्म्याच्या किंवा ईश्र्वराच्या सत्तेनें पृथ्वी व्यापली आहे. ठिकठिकाणीं ती सत्ताच व्यवस्था निर्माण करते. ज्या सत्तेच्या प्रेरणेनें अनेक प्रकारच्या विद्या, कला आणि धारणा प्रगट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That One pervades the earth element due to His power and He controls every place due to His power. But then this `art' of knowing (ie. His power) becomes the `many' learnings and the `many' understandings.

owis.original: दृश्य अवघेंचि पाहावें । स्थानमान सांभाळावें । सारासार विचारावें । नरदेहे जालियां ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून नरदेह हातीं आल्यावर हें सगळें दृश्य पहावें. व्यवहारामधील आपलें स्थान आणी मान दोन्ही सांभाळावेत. आणि सारासार विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: He should understand that this `all' has appeared as these `many' things and He should protect this most respected of places. And then, on account of this human body, there should be that thoughtless essence.

owis.original: येहलोक आणी परलोक । नाना प्रकारींचा विवेक । विवेक आणी अविवेक । मनुष्य जाणे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इहलोक आणि परलोक अनेक प्रकारचे इतर विवेक, शिवाय विवेक आणि अविवेक या गोष्टी माणूसच जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This world and the world beyond; the `many' forms of vivek; vivek and avivek are all known to man.

owis.original: नाना पिंडीं ब्रह्मांडरचना । नाना मुळींची कल्पना । नाना प्रकारीं धारणा । मनुष्य जाणे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारच्या पिंडांची रचना, ब्रह्मांडरचना, मूळमायेंतील अनेक कल्पना, अनेक प्रकारच्या ध्यान धारणा माणूस जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Man knows this construction of the brahmanda within the `many' pindas; man knows that the `many' is the imaginings of this root and man knows the `many' forms of understanding.

owis.original: अष्टभोग नवरस । नाना प्रकारींचा विळास । वाच्यांश लक्ष्यांश सारांश । मनुष्य जाणे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अन्न, उदक, तांबूल, पुष्प, चंदन, वसन, शय्या व अलंकार हे आठही प्रकारचे भोग किंवा सुगंध, स्त्री, तांबूल,वस्त्र, गायन, भोजन, शय्या आणि मादक द्रव्य हे आठ भोग, नऊ प्रकारचे रस, अनेक विलास, वाच्यांश, लक्ष्यांश व सारांश या गोष्टी माणूसच जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Man knows the eight pleasures, nine types of emotions/sentiments, the `many' forms of playfulness; the word meaning and the implied meaning, the essence.

owis.original: मनुष्यें सकळांस आळिलें । त्या मनुष्यास देवें पाळिलें । ऐसे हें अवघें कळलें । नरदेहयोगें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूसइतर सर्व प्राण्यांना आपल्या ताब्यांत ठेवतो. पण माणसाला देव पाळतो, सांभाळतो. आपल्या ताब्यांत ठेवतो. या सार्‍या गोष्टी मानव देहांतच कळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that man has control over this `all' then, that man is protected by God. In this way, thoughtlessness or the `many' things can be understood, due to ones union with a human body.

owis.original: नरदेह परम दुल्लभ । येणें घडे अलभ्य लाभ । दुल्लभ तें सुल्लभ । होत आहे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मानवदेह अत्यंत दुर्लभ आहे. त्याच्या योगानें अलभ्य लाभ प्राप्त होतो. जी गोष्ट दुर्लभ आहे ती सुलभ होते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this human body remains then, that Supreme is most difficult to attain; still on account of thoughtlessness, that unattainable is attained and this most difficult to acquire is easily acquired.

owis.original: वरकड देहे हे काबाड । नरदेह मोठें घबाड । परंतु पाहिजे जाड । विवेकरचना ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इतर देह हे रसहीन आहेत. नुसते कष्टकारक आहेत. पण मानवदेह म्हणजे फार मोठे घबाड आहे. त्याचा संपूर्ण फायदा होण्यास अतिशय मोठा किंवा विशाल विवेक केला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: In other bodies, thoughtlessness has become a heavy load. The human body is a great treasure, because that brahman can be understood. But for this, the forming of real vivek is required.

owis.original: येथें जेणें आळस केला । तो सर्वस्वें बुडाला । देव नाहीं वोळखिला । विवेकबळें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाचा देह मिळूनही जो आळशीपणानें वागतो, तो सर्व बाजूंनी बुडतो. त्याचे सर्वस्वीं नुकसान होते. कारण विवेकाच्या बळानें तो देवाची ओळख करुन घेत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If this mula maya becomes lazy `here' then, that brahman and this wealth of the `all' are drowned. But through powerful, continuous vivek even God is not (ie. when the known is merged in that swarup, then the Knower does not remain).

owis.original: नर तोचि नारायेण । जरी प्रत्ययें करी श्रवण । मननशीळ अंतःकर्ण । सर्वकाळ ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याचे अंतःकरण निरंतर मननशील असतें आणि जो श्रवण केलेल्याचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेतो. तो देहानें माणूस असला तरी देवपदाच्या पदवीला चढतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If a man/nara makes shravan then, due to this nirgun understanding he becomes narayana. Then His antah-karana should possess manana all the `time'.

owis.original: जेणें स्वयेंचि पोहावें । त्यास कासेस नलगे लागावें । स्वतंत्रपणें शोधावें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला स्वतःला पोहायला येते, त्याला दुसर्‍याची कास धरण्याची गरज लागत नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें जो मननशील आहे, त्यानें सर्व कांहीं स्वतंत्रपणें शोधून पहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this mula maya, one will naturally be kept afloat and then, what will be required by Him? Then by remaining independent, this `all thing' will be purified.

owis.original: सकळ शोधून राहिला । संदेह कैचा तयाला । पुढें विचार कैसा जाला । त्याचा तोचि जाणे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आशा रीतीनें सर्व विष्वाचा जो स्वतंत्रपणें शोध घेतो, त्याला कोणताहि संदेह उरत नाहीं. अशा रीतीनें संपूर्ण संदेहरहित झाल्यावर पुढें जी अवस्था येते ती त्याची त्यालाच समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `all' has been purified then, how can body consciousness remain for Him? Then afterwards when thoughtlessness has come, how will this `all' be know by that brahman? .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Atma Guna Nirupan (A Discourse on the Qualities of the Atma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जलजा नवलक्षााश्च दशलक्षाश्च पक्षिणः । कृमयोरुद्रलक्षाश्च विंशल्लक्षा गवादयः ।। स्थावरास्त्रिंशल्लक्षाश्च चतुर्लक्षाश्च मानवाः । पापपुण्यं समं कृत्वा नरयोनिषु जायते ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्यांत जन्मणारे नऊ लाख, पक्षी दहा लाख, कृमी किटक अकरा लाख, गाईबैलांसारखें पशु वीस लाख, वृक्षादि स्थावर तीस लाख, माणसें चार लाख, पाप पुण्य सारख्याप्रमाणांत असेल तेव्हां नरदेहाची प्राप्ति होते.
owis.englishMeaning: If one tries to understand this world, then this great water element will be everywhere (ie. the gross becomes less objective). But if this soft objectification of the water element is not (ie. if one does not try to understand this world) then, that pure One within the `many' is this raised stony ground made from the earth element (ie. appears as a gross body).

owis.original: तैसें दृश्य विस्तारलें । कांहीयेक जाणीवेनें शोभलें । जाणीवरहित उरलें । कितीयेक दृश्य ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्याचा विस्तार हा असाच आहे. दृश्यांपैकीं कांहीं भाग जाणिवेनें शोभतो तर कांहीं भाग जाणिवरहित असतो. दृश्याचा जाणिवरहित भाग बराच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if one forgets everything that one has learned up until now and just knows then, one will become less and less objective and this visible `all' will expand and that One within the `thing' will shine. And when this visible `all' is unaccompanied by this knowing then, what remains is that One (then knowledge is absorbed in no knowledge).

owis.original: च्यारी खाणी च्यारी वाणी । चौर्‍यासी लक्ष जीवयोनी । शास्त्रीं अवघें नेमुनी । बोलिलें असे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणीवेनें शोभणारें जें दृश्य आहे, त्याच्या चार खाणी चार वाणी,चौर्‍यांशी लक्ष जीवयोनी आहेत. शास्त्रामध्यें हें सारे व्यवस्थितपणें सांगितलेलें आहे. श्र्चोक
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise there are the four sources of birth and the four speeches and there is the attention of the eighty-four principles that make up a jiva. But when these `many' thoughts are established in the understanding of the shasthras (ie. finally they said neti, neti) then, there is this `speech' (or knowing). || loka || jalaj navalakca daalakca pakia | kmayo rudralakca viallak gavdaya || sthvar striallakca caturlakca mnav | ppapuya sama ktv narayoniu jyate || || Shloka || As below

owis.original: मनुष्यें च्यारी लक्ष । पशु वीस लक्ष । क्रिम आक्रा लक्ष । बोलिलें शास्त्रीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसें चार लक्ष, पशु वीस लक्ष, कृमी अकरा लक्ष, असें शास्त्रांत सांगितलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the four laksha of human beings, twenty laksha of animals, eleven laksha of worms and insects and there is this `speech' that is within the shasthras (ie. know this `speech' and understand that all these different created bodies are but this one moving form ie. knowledge).

owis.original: दाहा लक्ष ते खेचर । नव लक्ष जळचर । तीस लक्ष स्थावर । बोलिलें शास्त्रीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दहा लाख पक्षी, नऊ लाख जलचर, तीस लाख स्थावर असें शास्त्र सांगतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality has appeared as ten laksha of birds; nine laksha of fish and other beings in the waters and *thirty laksha varieties of fixed/non-moving creatures. Yet still there is this `speech' that is within the shasthras. *(These total eighty-two, plus knowledge and ignorance makes eighty-four. laksha means one hundred thousand and it also means, attention. Therefore when this `speech' is forgotten then, there is the attention of this rajo guna or imagination and on account of this imagination, that formless swarup appears as all these different forms made up of the eighty-four principles,)

owis.original: ऐसी चौर्‍यासी लक्ष योनी । जितुका तितुका जाणता प्राणी । अनंत देह्याची मांडणी । मर्यादा कैंची ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चौर्‍यांशी लक्ष योनींचा हिशेब हा असा आहे. त्या मध्यें जितके प्राणी आहेत त्यांना जाणीव आहे, जाणतेपणा आहे. प्राण्यांच्या देहाची रचना अनंत प्रकारची आहे. त्या विविध प्रकारांना मुळी मर्यादा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Yet even when in the prana there is the birth of these eighty-four principles, still there is that atma who knows. How can there be any limit to this spread of bodies, for they have come from that limitless paramatma?

owis.original: अनंत प्राणी होत जाती । त्यांचें अधिष्ठान जगती । जगतीवेगळी स्थिती । त्यास कैंची ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अक्षरशः अनंत प्राणी जन्मास येतात आणि मृत्यु पावतात. पृथ्वी हा त्यांचा आधार आहे. पृथ्वीवांचून त्यंना जीवन जगणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And when that limitless paramatma gets born in the prana then, It comes and goes and gets born and dies. Yet still within this gross imagined world of the jiva there is this original place of that paramatma. But other than this gross world, where can the jiva stay? (That paramatma has become jivatma and due to Its ignorance, It is confined to this gross existence).

owis.original: पुढें पाहातां पंचभूतें । पावलीं पष्टदशेतें । कोणी विद्यमान कोणी तें । उगीच असती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यानंतर पुढें विचार केला तर व्यक्त दशेला आलेली पंचभूतें आढळतात. पंचभूतांपैकीं कांहीं इंद्रियगोचर आहेत. तर कांहीं इंद्रियांना दिसत नाहींत. गुप्त असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: And yet if from now on you inquire into and understand the five great elements then, this `all' clearly manifests. Then afterwards one may have this power of knowledge or one may be that still and silent Reality (having acquired this knowledge, one may inquire further and go beyond knowledge).

owis.original: अंतरात्म्याची वोळखण । तेचि जेथें चपळपण । जाणीवेचें अधिष्ठान । सावध ऐका ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें चंचलपणा आहे तेथें अंतरात्मा आहे असें ओळखावें. आतां जाणीवेचे राहाणें कोठें कोठें असतें तें सावधपणें ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this `all' accompanying that antar-atma then, that Reality becomes very active `here' in maya (ie. one moving form or chaitanya). Therefore one should forget everything and listen alertly to this original place of knowing.

owis.original: सुखदुख जाणता जीव । तैसाचि जाणावा सदाशिव । अंतःकर्णपंचक अपूर्व । अंश आत्मयाचा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सुख आणि दुःख याची जाणीव जीवाला असते. त्याचप्रमाणें ती सदाशिवाला म्हणजे जगदीश्वराला पण असते. विलक्षण असें अंतःकरणपंचक म्हणजे अंतःकरण, मन, बुद्धि, चित्त आणि अहंकार हा अंतरात्म्याचा अंश होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is pleasure and pain then, that Knower is a jiva. And when there is no pleasure and pain then, that Knower should be known as *sada-shiva (ie. the One who is always knowing). Then this five-fold antah-karana of the jiva is a part of that atma (still mind, buddhi, chitta and ego are there but `now' they have transcended this small body of the jiva and they regard this `all' body of knowledge). (maharaj- shiva means to touch; He takes the touch of knowledge)

owis.original: स्थुळीं आकाशाचे गुण । अंश आत्मयाचे जाण । सत्व रज तमोगुण । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्थूलामध्यें आकाशाचे गुण म्हणजे काम, क्रोध, भय, शोक, मोह असे आत्म्याचे अंश समजावें. तसेंच सत्त्व, रज व तम हेहि आत्म्याचे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this gross body, there is this guna of space (ie. pure sattwa). Know this as part of that atma. The sattwa, rajo and tamo gunas of the jiva are due to this guna of that atma. (This is the antar-atma ie. when that pure atma is in the companionship of maya. Then there is this quality of effortless knowing and from this one can `look outside' and then the elements and gross world will be created or one can hold to this knowing with firm conviction and that pure atma while be realized)

owis.original: नाना चाळणा नाना धृती । नवविधा भक्ति चतुर्विधा मुक्ती । अलिप्तपण सहजस्थिती । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारचे विवेकयुक्य विचार, धैर्य, नवविधा भक्ति, चार प्रकारच्या मुक्ति अलिप्तपणा सहजस्थिति,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' searches and the `many' firm commitments; there are the nine bhakti/devotions and the four liberations; there is remaining aloof and that natural state; due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: द्रष्टा साक्षी ज्ञानघन । सत्ता चैतन्य पुरातन । श्रवण मनन विवरण । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्रष्टा, साक्षी, ज्ञानघन, सत्ता, चैतन्य, पुरातन, श्रवण, मनन, विवरण,
owis.englishMeaning: The seer, the witness, the full of knowledge; the power, the chaitanya and the `most ancient'; shravan, manana and that investigation of thoughtlessness are due to this guna of atma.

owis.original: दृश्य द्रष्टा दर्शन । ध्येय ध्याता ध्यान । ज्ञेय ज्ञाता ज्ञान । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्य, द्रष्टा-दर्शन, ध्येय, ध्याता, ध्यान, ज्ञेय, ज्ञाता, ज्ञान,
owis.englishMeaning: The seen, the seer and the act of seeing; the object of meditation, the meditator and the act of meditation; the knowing, the Knower and this knowledge are due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: वेदशास्त्रपुराणअर्थ । गुप्त चालिला परमार्थ । सर्वज्ञपणें समर्थ । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेद, शास्त्र, पुराणें, यांचा अर्थ, गुप्तपणें चाललेला परमार्थ, सर्वज्ञपणानें आलेलें सामर्थ्य,
owis.englishMeaning: The meaning of the vedas, shasthras and mythological books; the hidden purush that maintains paramarth and that non-dual understanding are due to this `all-knowingness' of the guna of that atma .

owis.original: बद्ध मुमुक्ष साधक सिद्ध। विचार पाहाणें शुद्ध । बोध आणि प्रबोध । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बद्ध,मुमुक्ष, साधक, सिद्ध, शुद्ध, विचार करणें, बोध प्रबोध,
owis.englishMeaning: The bonded, the seeker/mumukshu, the aspirant/sadhak and the accomplished/si- ddha; to understand thoughtlessness; the teachings and the imbibing of the teachings are all due to this guna of the atma.

owis.original: जागृति स्वप्न सुषुप्ति तुर्या । प्रकृतिपुरुष मूलमाया । पिंड ब्रह्मांड अष्टकाया । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जागृति, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति, तुर्या, प्रकृतिपुरुष, मूळमाया, पिंड, ब्रह्मांड, आठ देह,
owis.englishMeaning: The states of wakefulness, of dream and of deep sleep and the fourth state of prakriti/purush or mulamaya; the eight bodies of the pinda and the brahmanda; are because of this guna of that atma.

owis.original: परमात्मा आणि परमेश्र्वरी । जगदात्मा आणी जगदेश्र्वरी । महेश आणी माहेश्र्वरी । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्मा व परमेश्र्वरी; जगदात्मा व जगदीश्वरी; महेश व माहेश्र्वरी,
owis.englishMeaning: paramatma and parameshwari; the atma of the world and the goddess of the world; mahesh and maheshwari; are due to this guna of that atma. (The purush/male silently abiding with His female counterparts).

owis.original: सूक्ष्म जितुकें नामरुप । तितुकें आत्मयाचें स्वरुप । संकेतनामाभिधानें अमूप । सीमा नाहीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हे सर्व प्रकार आत्म्याचे गुण आहेत. जेवढें म्हणून सूक्ष्म नामरुप आहे, तेवढें सर्व अंतरात्म्याचें स्वरुप आहे. अशा सूक्ष्म नामरुपाच्या संकेतांची नांवें खूपच आहेत. त्यांना मर्यादा नाहीं. सूक्ष्माच्या प्रातांत अंतरात्मा जाणिवेची इतकी अनंत रुपें घेतों, कीं त्यांना कांहीं सीमाच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Even when that brahman is this `name' and `form' of the `all', then also, this `all' is that swarup of the atma. And due to the assigning of this `name' (ie. knowing), there is that immeasurable which has no limit (this `name'/knowledge is a pointer to that atma; it is the manifestation of the unmanifest and the way back to that unmanifest).

owis.original: आदिशक्ती शिवशक्ती । मुख्य मूळमाया सर्वशक्ती । नाना जीनस उत्पत्ती स्थिती । तितुके गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आदिशक्ति, शिवशक्ति, मुख्य मूळमाया, सर्व प्रकारच्या शक्ति, नाना पदार्थाची उत्पत्ति व स्थिति,
owis.englishMeaning: There is this original-shakti or shiva-shakti and then, that thoughtless Supreme is mula maya and this is the power of the `all'. There is the birth and maintenance of the `many' objects and they are all due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: पूर्वपक्ष आणी सिद्धांत । गाणें वाजवणें संगीत । नाना विद्या अद्भुत । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वपक्ष आणि सिद्धान्त, गाणेंबजावणें, संगीत, नाना अद्भुत विद्या,
owis.englishMeaning: This original hypothesis (`I am') and that siddhant (I am not); the composition of His `song' and the making of sweet music; the `many' learnings and this great wonder of the `all'; are all due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: ज्ञान अज्ञान विपरीत ज्ञान । असद्वृत्ति सद्वृत्ति जाण । ज्ञेप्तिमात्र अलिप्तपण । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञान, अज्ञान, विपरित ज्ञान, असद्वृत्ति, सद्वृत्ति, ज्ञानमात्र, अलिप्तपणा,
owis.englishMeaning: Knowledge, ignorance and false knowledge; the false vrittis (thoughts created by "I know this and that") and the true vritti (`I know'); that pure knowledge and aloofness; are due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: पिंड ब्रह्मांड तत्वझाडा । नाना तत्वांचा निवाडा । विचार पाहाणें उघडा । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडब्रह्मांडांतील तत्वांचा शोध, अनेक तत्वांचा निवाडा, स्पष्टपणें विचार करणें,
owis.englishMeaning: The pinda and brahmanda and the elimination of gross elements; the choosing of these `many' elements; the understanding and opening out of thoughtlessness; are all due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: नाना ध्यानें अनुसंधानें । नाना स्थिति नाना ज्ञानें । अनन्य आत्मनिवेदनें । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रकारचे ध्यान, अनुसंधान, अनेक प्रकारच्या स्थिति, अनेक प्रकारचें ज्ञान, अनन्य आत्मनिवेदन,
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' meditations are due to this attention; the `many' states and the `many' knowledges; the surrendering of this `I am' to the atma; is due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: तेतिस कोटी सुरवर । आठ्यासी सहश्र ऋषेश्र्वर । भूत खेचर अपार । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेहतीस कोटी देव, अठ्ठ्याऐशी हजार ऋषी, असंख्य भूतपिशाच्चें,
owis.englishMeaning: There are gods of the senses who are these *thirty-three principles and that pure sattwa (ie. each sense is said to have its own deity); and along with that `Lord of the rishi', there is the eighty-four principles and four births and these make so many jivas; there are the elements, the sky and that limitless Self. All this is due to this guna of that atma. *(Twenty-five divisions of the great elements, the five great elements and the three gunas)

owis.original: भूतावळी औट कोटी । च्यामुंडा छपन्न कोटी । कात्यायेणी नव कोटी । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साडेतीन कोटी भुतावळ, छप्पन कोटी चामुंडा, नऊ कोटी कात्यायनी,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the great elements that become the `many' forms and this original sound aum; there are the fifty-six principles along with that pure sattwa that create this body made of leather (twenty-five gross and twenty five subtle, four forms of birth and ignorance and knowledge); there are these *nine principles along with that pure sattwa and these bring about all the killing and beatings in this gross existence. These are all due to this guna of that atma (knowledge). *(five elements and four births)

owis.original: चंद्र सूर्य तारामंडळें । नाना नक्षत्रें ग्रहमंडळें । शेष कूर्म मेघमंडळें । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंद्र, सूर्य, तारामंडळ, अनेक नक्षत्रें, ग्रहमंडळें, शेष, कूर्म, मेघमंडळें,
owis.englishMeaning: The moon, the sun and stars; the `many' constellations and planetary systems; that serpent shesh (that purush who remains when everything has been made to nothing);4 the great turtle and the other *avatars of vishnu who support this gross creation; the cover of the clouds of ignorance; are all due to this guna of that atma. *(The great turtle and other avatars of vishnu have knowledge as their bodies and each of these are said to support this gross existence)

owis.original: देव दानव मानव । नाना प्रकारीचे जीव । पाहातां सकळ भावाभाव । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, दानव, मानव, अनेक प्रकारचे जीव, सर्व प्रकारचे भाव आणि अभाव असणें आणि नसणें, हे सगळें आत्म्याचेच गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The gods (knowledge), the demons (ignorance) and man (knowledge and ignorance); 4 siddharameshwar maharaj- When knowledge is discarded, shesha remains. That is "knowing" and that is shesha narayana the hidden within the known. Therefore it is said he stays in the lower world (the causal body) and he upholds this world on one of his one thousand heads. After knowledge has been discarded he remains, for he can neither be left aside nor taken up; such is this that is "beyond the elements." and the `many' ways of the jivas are due to this guna of the atma. When you understand this `all' and *being and non-being, it is due to this guna of that atma. *(The `all' is being and the jiva is non-being)

owis.original: आत्मयाचे नाना गुण । ब्रह्म निर्विकार निर्गुण । जाणणें येकदेसी पूर्ण । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें त्या अंतरात्म्याचे अनेक गुण आहेत. ब्रह्म मात्र निर्गुण आणि निर्विकार आहे. जाणणें किंवा जाणीव असणें हा अंतरात्म्याचा गुण आहे.मग ती जाणीव पूर्ण असो किंवा अपूर्ण व एकदेशी असो.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' gunas are due to this guna of that atma; as is that nirgun brahman, free of any modification. To know, and the limited and the complete are due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: आत्मारामउपासना । तेणें पावले निरंजना । निसंदेहे अनुमाना । ठावचि नाहीं ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा प्रकारच्या अनेक गुणांनी अंतरात्मा दृश्यामध्यें पूर्ण भरलेला आहे. असा त्याला पाहाणें ही त्याची उपासना होय. अशी उपासना जो करील त्याला निरंजन ब्रह्म प्राप्त होईल व तो निःसंदेह होईल. निःसंदेह अवस्थेंत कल्पनेला वाव राहात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This guna is the worship of atmaram and due to this, that niranjan is attained. That is beyond all the eight bodies and there is no place for conjecture there. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Atma Nirupan (A Discourse on the Atma)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: अनुर्वाच्य समाधान जालें । तें पाहिजे बोलिलें । बोलिल्यासाठीं समाधान गेलें । हें तो घडेना ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मसाक्षात्कार होऊन शब्दांनीं सांगता न येणारे समाधान प्राप्त झालें. तरी पण तें सांगितलें पाहिजे. कारण या समाधानाचे शब्दांनी वर्णन केलें तर तर तें समाधान नाहींसें झालें असें कधी होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if that inexpressible complete contentment has come, still that Reality requires this `speech' (by means of this `speech'/knowledge that Reality can function in the world). But if one takes oneself to be this knowledge then, that complete contentment is destroyed and that thoughtless paramatma has not been accomplished.

owis.original: कांहीं सांडावें लागत नाहीं । कांहीं मांडावें लागत नाहीं । येक विचार शोधून पाहीं । म्हणिजे कळे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समाधान प्राप्त करुन घेण्यासाठीं कांहीं सोडावें लागत नाहीं. व कांहीं नवीन मांडावें लागत नाहीं. एका विचारानें शोध घेतला म्हणजे तें कळतें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' does not have to be dropped nor does it have to be established for it is already present (only the thoughts have to be dropped; maharaj- at this moment you are He). And with this `thing', one should search out and understand that thoughtless swarup.

owis.original: मुख्य कासीविश्र्वेश्र्वर । श्र्वेतबंद रामेश्र्वर । मलकार्जुन भीमाशंकर । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुख्य काशीविश्र्वेश्र्वर, मग सेतुबंध रामेश्र्चर, मल्लिकार्जुन, भीमाशंकर,
owis.englishMeaning: The temples of kashi-vishweshara;5 setubandha rameshwara; mallikarjuna and bheema-shankar (ie. north, south, east and west) and that thoughtless Supreme are all due to this guna of that atma. (This atma is the antar-atma and on account of Him there is this pure sattwa guna and due to this effortless knowing, the world has appeared and also, that Reality can be realized. This knowledge is everywhere, it is north, south, east and west)

owis.original: जैसीं मुख्य बारा लिंगें । यावेगळीं अनंत लिंगें । प्रचित जाणिजेत जगें । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशीं मुख्य बारा ज्योतिर्लिंगें आहेत. त्याशिवाय आणखी पुष्कळ लिंगें आहेत. त्यांची प्रचीति अनेक लोकांना येते. पण हें आत्म्याचे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this guna of knowledge, that thoughtless Supreme has appeared as the twelve jyoti lingams (due to this guna, thoughtlessness is not and there appears this gross world where there are the twelve important jyoti lingams and `many' sacred sites). This knowing is different to thoughtlessness and these lingams. And to stay as this `I am' experience one should know this guna of that atma (we are that atma and It possesses this effortless knowing; but to understand these things, the thoughts of this world, of lingams and sacred places, have to be left).

owis.original: भूमंडळीं अनंत शक्ति । नाना साक्षात्कार चमत्कार होती । नाना देवांच्या सामर्थ्यमूर्ती । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर अनंत शक्ति आहेत. अनेकांना त्यांचा साक्षात्कार होतो. त्या शक्तीचें अनेक चमत्कार दृष्टीस पडतात. त्याचप्रमाणें अनेक देवांच्या सामर्थ्यसंपन्न मूर्ति आहेत. हे आत्म्याचे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That endless atma and His power/shakti is within this world. Thus the `many' miracles and that satkshatkar (nirgun realization), the `many' gods and this powerful image (`all') of that God; are due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: नाना सिद्धांची सामर्थ्यें । नाना मंत्रांचीं सामर्थ्यें । नाना मोहरेवल्लींत सामर्थ्यें । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक सिद्धपुरुषांचे सामर्थ्य, अनेक मंत्रांचें सामर्थ्य, सर्पाच्या मस्तकावर असणार्‍या मण्याचे सामर्थ्य, अनेक वनस्पतींचें सामर्थ्य,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this power of the accomplished there are the `many' accomplishments; due to this the power of mantra (`I am') there are the `many' mantras;6 due to this power of the `experience' there are the `many' experiences upon this creeper called maya; and all this is due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: नाना तीर्थांची सामर्थ्यें । नाना क्षेत्रांची सामर्थ्यें । नाना भूंमडळीं सामर्थ्यें । गुण आत्मयाचे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक तीर्थांचें व क्षेत्रांचे सामर्थ्य, जगांतील अनेक प्रकारचे सामर्थ्य अशी अनेक प्रकारची सामर्थ्यें आत्म्याचे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The powers of the `many' sacred rivers are due to this power; the powers of `many' pilgrimage places are due to this power; for the `many' powers within this world are due to this power of that atma.

owis.original: जितुके कांहीं उत्तम गुण । तितुकें आत्मयाचे लक्षण । बरें वाईट तितुकें जाण । आत्म्याचकरितां ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेवढे म्हणून उत्तम गुणआहेत, तेवढें सगळें आत्म्याचे लक्षण समजावें. परंतु जेवढें बरें वाईट आढळतें तेवढें सारें आत्म्यामुळें असतें. हें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever there is this `thing'/prakruti there is this best guna and then that atma is knowing. Know that this best guna and the worst gunas are all on account of that atma.

owis.original: शुद्ध आत्मा उत्तम गुणी । सबळ आत्मा अवलक्षणी । बरी वाईटआवघी करणी । आत्मयाची ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा शुद्ध असला म्हणजे उत्तम गुण प्रगट करतो. तोच आत्मा मिश्रित असतो तेव्हां अवलक्षणें प्रगट करतो. बरी आणि वाईट करणी अखेर आत्म्याचीच असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: 6 siddharameshwar maharaj what you say is a mantra, `bring me water' and water appears. Is this not power! 9. That atma is pure within the best guna and that atma is impure within this false attention (ie. then It takes Itself to be a body); therefore the best guna and the worst gunas that are within everyone are the wondrous doing of that atma.

owis.original: नाना साभिमान धरणें । नाना प्रतिसृष्टी करणें । नाना श्रापउश्रापलक्षणें । आत्मयाचेनी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारचा अभिमान धरणें, प्रतिसृष्टि निर्माण करणें, अनेक प्रकारचे शाप देणें व उःशाप देणें ही सगळी आत्म्याची लक्षणें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: To hold the `many' arrogances and the `many' actions of the gross world; to have the attention that brings this curse of `many' bodies ("I am a body and this is my boy, wife" etc.) and the attention that brings the mitigation of that curse (ie. understanding `I am He'), are due to this guna of that atma.

owis.original: पिंडाचा बरा शोध घ्यावा । तत्वांचा पिंड शोधावा । तत्वें आत्माशोधितां पिंड आघवा । कळों येतो ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधकानें आपल्या देहाचा शोध नीटपणें घ्यावा. त्यामध्यें स्थूल, सूक्ष्म तत्वें नीट शोधावीत. त्तवांचा शोध केल्यानें पिंडाची सबंध रचना कळून येते.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the *wise should accept this search of the pinda; they should search through these gross elements that make up this body; if you search these gross elements then, the pinda and this world of `many' things can be understood by that atma. *(The wise are the ones who drop this inferior attention and witness).

owis.original: जड देह भूतांचा । चंचळ गुण आत्मयाचा । निश्र्चळ ब्रह्मावेगळा ठाव कैचा । जेथें तेथें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तत्वांचा शोध केला तर असें आढळतें कीं, देह जड आहे. पंचभूतांचा आहे. देहामधील चंचळपणा किंवा जाणीव हा अंतरात्म्याचा गुण आहे. त्याचबरोबर निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म सर्वव्यापी असल्यानें तें नाहीं असें स्थानच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The inert, gross body that has come from the great elements and this moving `all' are on account of this guna of that atma. But when `here' goes `there' then, how can there be any place other than that still brahman? (tukaram- sagun and nirgun, everything is govinda)

owis.original: निश्र्चळ चंचळ आणी जड । पिंडीं करावा निवाड । प्रत्ययावेगळें जाड । बोलणें नाहीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला पिंड जड देह, चंचळ आत्मा आणि निश्र्चळ परब्रह्म ही तीन तत्वें मिळून बनतो. या तत्वांचा निवाडा आपल्या पिंडांतच करुन घ्यावा. आनुभव घेतल्यावांचून बोलण्यास वजन येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the still, the moving and the inert/gross and these should be determined within the pinda. Therefore understand that this `speech' could not be present without that pure thoughtless nirgun.

owis.original: पिंडामधून आत्मा जातो । तेव्हां निवाडा कळों येतो । देहे जड हा पडतो । देखतदेखतां ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा पिंडांतून निघून जातो. त्याप्रसंगी तत्वांचा निर्णय ध्यानांत येतो. आपल्या देखत पाहतां पाहतां देह जड होऊन पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma within the *pinda leaves then, one can easily understand that they were quite separate (maharaj- this body is a dead body at the moment. The power is there so it can speak). But taking ourself to be this inert body, that atma has come tumbling down from Its place, before your very eyes. *(When a dead corpse is seen on the funeral pyre, some get what is called, burning ground vairagya)

owis.original: जड तितुके पडिले । चंचळ तितुकें निघोनी गेलें । जडचंचळाचें रुप आलें । प्रत्ययासी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जड तेवढें निश्र्चेष्ट पडतें.चंचळ तेवढें देह सोडून निघून जातें. पण या शनुभवावरुन जड व चंचळ यांचें स्वरुप आपल्या अनुभवास येते.
owis.englishMeaning: But when due to that thoughtless understanding, the inert ceases and the moving goes away (ie. both the gross body and knowledge are rejected), then the inert and moving form becomes that nirgun understanding.

owis.original: निश्र्चळ आहे सकळां ठांई । हें तों पाहाणें नलगे कांहीं । गुणविकार तेथें नाहीं । निश्र्चळासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निश्चळ मुळीं सर्व ठिकाणीं व्यापून आहे. तें कांहीं पहावें लागत नाहीं. निश्चळ स्वरुपांत कोणताच गुणविकार नसतो. केव्हांहि व कोठेंहि तें अगदी जसेंच्या तसेंच राहतें.
owis.englishMeaning: This place of the `all' is that still brahman and if that thoughtless swarup wants to understand Its Self then, this `thing' is not required (ie. no-knowledge is required). For when this modified guna of knowing is not then, `there' is that still swarup.

owis.original: जैसें पिंड तैसें ब्रह्मांड । विचार दिसतो उघड । जड चंचळ जातां जाड । परब्रह्मचि आहे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडाच्या बाबतींत जें खरें तेंच ब्रह्मांडाच्या बाबतींत खरें असतें. हा विचार अगदी उघड आहे. स्पष्ट आहे. जड आणि चंचळ नाहींसें झालें कीं, सर्व व्यापी घनदाट परब्रह्म तेवढें शिल्लक उरते.
owis.englishMeaning: When one understands that the brahmanda is inert just like the pinda then, that thoughtless atma is seeing clearly. Then the inert and moving are destroyed and there is the Truth, and that is parabrahman.

owis.original: माहांभूतांचा खंबीर केला । आत्मा घालून पुतळा जाला । चालिला सृष्टीचा गल्बला । येणें रीतीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महाभूतांचा खंबीर केला-----म्हणजे रांधा करुन आंबवलेली कणिक----- त्यामध्यें आत्मा घातला, म्हणजे त्यामध्यें जाणीव घातली, तेव्हा त्याचा पुतळा तयार झाला. अशा रीतीनें पृथ्वीचा खटाटोप चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this structure made of the five great elements gets created (by objectification) then, that atma is taken to be this inert statue. And in this way, there are the confused actions of the gross world.

owis.original: आत्मा माया विकार करी । आळ घालिती ब्रह्मावरी । प्रत्ययें सकळ कांहीं विवरी । तोचि भला ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरें म्हणजे माया व अंतरात्मा सर्व बदल घडवून आणतात. पण ब्रह्मावर त्याचा आरोप घातला जातो. जो कोणी या सगळ्या गोष्टींचें विचारानें विवरण करतों तोच मनुष्य उत्तम होय.
owis.englishMeaning: This antar-atma and maya create the modifications but the blame is put on brahman. However if one investigates this `all thing' then, it gets merged in that brahman and one becomes That.

owis.original: ब्रह्म व्यापक अखंड । वरकड व्यापकता खंड । शोधून पाहातां जड । कांहींच नाहीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्माची व्यापकता अगदी अखंड आहे. त्यामुळें त्याच्या ठिकाणीं बदल घडण्यास अवकाश असतो. नीट विचार करुन शोधून पाहिलें तर यांत समजण्यास अवघड असें कांहीं नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: brahman is the One who pervades (ie. antar-atma) and that unbroken parabrahman. But the people of this world have a broken pervasiveness. However if they make a careful search then, this inanimate creation will be understood and this `thing' even will not remain.

owis.original: गगनासी खंडता नये । गगनाचें नासेल काये । जरी जाला माहांप्रळये । सृष्टीसंव्हार ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशाला खंडित करतां येत नाहीं. आकाशाला आपण भेगा पाडूं शकत नाहीं. म्हणून महाप्रलय होऊन सृष्टीचा संव्हार झाला तरी आकाशाचा मुळींच नाश होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be no break in the sky. How can there be the destruction of the sky? For even when there is the great dissolution by vivek then, it is the gross creation that gets destroyed (therefore be like the sky).

owis.original: जें संव्हारामध्यें सांपडले । तें सहजचि नासिवंत जालें । जाणते लोकीं उगविलें । पाहिजे कोडें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें संहातामधें सांपडते ते स्वाभाविकपणें नाशवंत असतें. विचारवंत जाणत्या लोकांनी हें कोडें सोडविलें पाहिजे. त्यांनीं या गूढ गोष्टीचा उलगडा करणें जरुर आहे. जड आणि चंचळ दोन्ही आलें आणि गेलें तरी परब्रह्म अगदी जसेंच्या तसें कसें राहतें, हें सृष्टीचें कोडें आहे. जाणत्या लोकांनी त्याचा उलगडा करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: However when this mula maya is discovered after the dissolution of the gross then, that natural Reality is appearing as this destructible `all'. Still by this knowing, this riddle/puzzle within the world, can be opened out and understood.

owis.original: न कळतां वाटे कोडें । कळतां आवघें दिसें उघडें । म्हणोनी येकांतीं निवाडे । विचार पाहावा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण या विश्र्वरचनेची गंमत अशी आहे कीं, जोपर्यंत ती कळत नाहीं तोपर्यंत ती गूढ वाटते. पण ती कळली कीं तिच्यामध्यें कांहीं गूढ नाहीं, ती अगदी सरळ व उघडी आहे, असें कळतें. म्हणून एकांतामध्यें जावें आणि अत्यंत विचार करुन हें गूढ उकलावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When you do not understand that nirgun then, that hidden purush appears as some- thing else and when you understand that nirgun then, the seeing of the confused mind gets opened out (maharaj- be so open nothing remains). Therefore in your `aloneness', thoughtlessness should be understood.

owis.original: मिळतां प्रत्ययाचे संत । येकांतापरीस येकांत । केली पाहिजे सावचीत । नाना चर्चा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वानुभवसंपन्न असा कोणी संत भेटला तर मोठ्या सावधान चित्तानें अनेक विषयांवर त्याच्याशी चर्चा करावी. कारण अशा संताची भेट म्हणजे एकांतापेक्षांही मोठा एकांत असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When your thoughtlessness meets the nirgun of the Saint then, your `aloneness' is like His `aloneness'; then the `many' rumours become that pure knowledge.

owis.original: पाहिल्यावेगळें कळत नाहीं । कळतां कळतां संदेह नाहीं । विवेक पाहातां कोठेंचि नाहीं । मायाजाळ ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसानें शोधून पाहिलें नाहीं तर काहींच कळत नाहीं. त्याला कळूं लागले कीं कळतां कळतां त्याचे संदेह नाहींसे होतात. विवेकानें शोध केला तर मायाजाळ खरेंपणानें कोठेंच नाहीं अशी खात्री होते.
owis.englishMeaning: But without first understanding this sagun, that nirgun cannot be understood and if this understanding is maintained continuously, then any body consciousness does not remain (ie. all eight bodies are dissolved). For when you completely understand vivek then, this net of maya is nowhere!

owis.original: गगनीं आभाळ आलें । मागुती सवेंचि उडालें । आत्म्याकरितां दृश्य जालें । उडेल तैसें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांत अभ्र येतें आणि लगोलग लगेच नाहींसे होऊन जाते. या अंतरात्म्याच्या आश्रयानें हें दृश्य विश्र्व भासतें. पण विवेकानें भ्रम नाहींसा झाला कीं तें लगेच नाहींसे होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: In the sky, the clouds gathered and after, they dispersed of their own accord. Similarly, due to the atma, this visible appeared and due to its having appeared, it will fly away also (when you decide).

owis.original: मुळापासून सेवटवरी । विवेकी विवेकें विवरी । तोचि निश्र्चय थावरी । चळेना ऐसा ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विवेकी साधक विवेकानें विवरण करतां करतां अगदीं मूळमायेपासून अगदी शेवटपर्यंत जातो. आपल्या सूक्ष्म विवेकानें अशाश्वत तत्वांना तो बाजूस सारतो आणि जो कधी चळणार नाहीं असा स्वस्वरुप निश्र्चय करतो. त्याचा आत्मनिश्र्चय अत्यंत स्थिर असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the viveki investigates from the beginning through to the end then, there arises the conviction of that paramatma and that does not deviate.

owis.original: वरकड निश्र्चय अनुमानाचें । अनुमानें बोलतां काये वेंचे । जाणते पुरुष प्रचितीचे । ते तों मानीतना ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाकीचे निश्र्चय अनुमानाच्या बळावर केलेले असतात. अनुमानाच्या आधारानें बोलायला माणसाचें कांहींच जात नाहीं. पण जे साक्षात्कारी जाणते पुरुष असतात ते अनुमानाच्या बोलण्याला मानत नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: The convictions of the rest are conjectures and how can conjecture select this `speech'? But even when that purush knows this `experience' still, He is having no regard for His own Reality.

owis.original: उगें न बोलणें अनुमानाचें । अनुमानाचें कोण्या कामाचें । येथें सगट विचाराचें । काम नाहीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनुमानाचें उगीच बोलणें कामास येत नाहीं. येथें सरसकट तर्क चालवून काम भागत नाहीं. माणसाचा तर्क देखिल अखेर दृश्यामधें घोटाळत असल्यानें, अतींद्रिय क्षेत्रामध्यें त्याला योग्य संचार करतां येत नाहीं. तेथें तो लटका पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And tell me, if this `speech' of that still and silent swarup does become conjecture, then of what use is this conjecture? But `here' and this lumped together world of the `many' have no use of thoughtlessness (nobody wants to die).

owis.original: सगट विचार तो अविचार । कित्येक म्हणती येकंकार । येकंकार भ्रष्टाकार । करुं नये ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो विचार दृश्यामधें उपयोगी पडतो तोच जर सूक्ष्माच्या क्षेत्रांत वापरला तर तेथें अविचार ठरतो. कांहीं लोक त्याला एकंकार म्हणतात. एकंकार हा भ्रष्टाचार असतो. आपण तो करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: For when that thoughtless atma is this lumped together world then, that atma cannot think clearly. Then that One within the `many' is a jiva and says, "All this you see is Oneness." But that Oneness should not be made into this whirling confusion of a jiva (they may say, "Everything is One" but that is not their experience, it is intellectual understanding and so they are still lost in maya).

owis.original: कृत्रिम अवघें सांडावें । कांहीं येक शुद्ध घ्यावें । जाणजाणों निवडावें । सारासार ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें कृत्रिम आहे तें सारें सोडावें. जें शुद्ध असेल तें घ्यावें. पुनः पुनः समजून सारासार निवडावें. कृत्रिम म्हणजे सत्य नसून सत्यासारखें दिसतें तें, अर्थात् मिथ्या होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the `many' artificial things that have been created by imagination should be dropped and that One pure Self within this `thing' should be accepted. By continuous knowing (forget everything that is seen or perceived by the mind), that essence (I am not) should be chosen from this non-essence (`I am'). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dehe Kshetra Nirupan (A Discourse on the Body as the Field)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: विधीप्रपंचतरु वाढला । वाढतां वाढतां विस्तीर्ण जाला । फळेम येता विश्रांती पावला । बहुत प्राणी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवाच्या प्रपंचाचा वृक्ष वाढला. त्याची वाढ होतां होतां तो फारच विस्तारला. नंतर त्यास फळें आलीं. त्यावेळीं पुष्कळ प्रान्यांना समाधान मिळालें.
owis.englishMeaning: This tree of prapanch has been sown by lord brahma (ie. buddhi ie. it gives names and therefore forms to that which is without name and form and thus creates `many' objects) and it has grown and spread out so much. This `all' within the prana, can choose to have the fruits of this tree or it can attain complete rest (ie. parabrahman). (You can either chose this world of pleasures and pains ie. fruits of prapanch, or by constant investigation, this `all' will attain that perfect understanding of pure knowledge)

owis.original: नाना फळें रसाळें लागलीं । नाना जिनसी गोडीस आलीं । गोडी पाहावया निर्माण केलीं । नाना शरीरें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या प्रचंड वृक्षाला अनेक रसाळ फळें लागली आहेत. त्यांची गोडी अनेक पदार्थांमध्यें अनुभवास येते. ती गोडी चाखण्याकरितां अनेक शरीरें निर्माण झालीं. जीवाला पहावेसें वाटलें म्हणून डोळे निर्माण झालें. ऐकावेसे वाटलें म्हणून कान निर्माण झालें. चाखावेसेम वाटलें म्हणून जीभ निर्माण झालीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' fruits of pleasures and pains ripened, there was a growing fondness for these `many' objects. But these `many' objects had been created in order that their sweetness could be enjoyed by this `I am' body (ie. knowledge, then these pleasures and pains will be understood and this world will be fully enjoyed as it was meant to be enjoyed).

owis.original: निर्माण जाले उत्तम विषये । शरीरेंविण भोगितां नये । म्हणोनी निर्मिला उपाये । नाना शरीरें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम विषय निर्माण केलेलें असलेम तरी शरीराशिवाय त्यांचा भोग घेता येत नाहीं. तें भोग भोगण्याचे साधन म्हणून अनेक प्रकारचीम शरीरें निर्माण झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: This best guna (of effortless knowing) has appeared as these sense objects. But without this `I am' body, they should not be enjoyed (then that ever-aloof atma will enjoy His creation and never enter body consciousness). Therefore this `all' body that has created these `many' bodies, also created this remedy (ie. knowledge of this `all' body relieves the pains of samsar caused by this "I am a body" concept. You have have created these `many' objects. But when you come to realize that my attactment to them is the cause of my suffering then, you will search for this remedy).

owis.original: ज्ञानइंद्रियें निर्माण केलीं । भिन्न भिन्न गुणांचीं निर्मिलीं । येका शरीरासी लागलीं । परी वेगळालीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पांच ज्ञानेंद्रियें निर्माण केलीं. पण प्रत्येकाचा गुण निराळा आहे. ती सारीं एकाच शरीरांत राहतात. पण प्रत्येक इंद्रिय निराळे आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The sense organs were made by creating the *separate gunas. That One had been connected with this `all' body (ie. pure sattwa guna) but then, this was passed over and everything became gross. *(When that pure sattwa guna or knowing vritti separated from its purush, it set out on its own. Then it made companionship with the antah- karana and together they created a world of `many' objects. This was the mixing together of knowledge/sattwa and ignorance/tamo and this created the rajo guna. You know something is there ie. sattwa, but you don't know what it is ie. tamo, and this brings the mind and buddhi. The mind says, "Something is there but I don't know what it is" and so the buddhi gives it a name. This is the rajo guna; it creates something out of nothing. Then the chitta thinks thinks about this over and over and the ego claims he is the knower. Then you take this body as your own and use it to live in and use it to see this world. Thus names and forms get given to that which was previously undifferentiated; thus there appeared the separate senses in that which was previously just effortlessly knowing)

owis.original: श्रोत्रइंद्रिईं शब्द पडिला । त्याचा भेद पाहिजे कळला । ऐसा उपाये निर्माण केला । इंद्रियांमधें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द हा विषय कानाचा आहे. शब्दांचे भेद कळण्याची योजना, व्यवस्था कानाच्या ठिकाणीं केलेली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `word' fell into the organ of hearing and the `many' words were taken as true. This dividing up of that paramatma should be clearly understood and for this, a remedy was devised. This remedy that is within these sense organs is the `word' (when one sees with body consciousness then, atma consciousness is drowned by the `many' thoughts; therefore to understand that paramatma, the knowledge of the `word' is the only remedy).

owis.original: त्वचेइंद्रियें सीतोष्ण भासे । चक्षुइंद्रियें सकळ दिसे । इंद्रियांमधें गुण ऐसे । वेगळाले ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्वचेनें थंडपणा व गरमपणा याचे ज्ञान होतें. डोळ्यांनी सगळें पाहातां येते. ज्ञानेंद्रियांमध्यें अशा प्रकारचे वेगळे वेगळे गुण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: But due to the organ of touch, cold and hot appear; and due the organ of sight, this `all' is seen by the eyes (this `all object' is then seen as the `many' objects). And so, in the sense organs, this guna of the atma gets passed over (ie. when effortless knowing gets passed over then one takes oneself to be a body and wants to see and experience `many' different things. Then there is hot and cold, big and small etc. etc., where before there was just knowing).

owis.original: जिव्हेमधें रस चाखणें । घ्राणामधें परिमळ घेणें । इंद्रियांमधें वेगळाल्या गुणें । भेद केले ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जिभेनें रस चाखण्याचा गुण आहे. तर नाकांत वास घेण्याचा गुण आहे. अशा वेगवेगळ्या गुणांमुळें इंद्रियांत भेद झाला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In the tongue, taste gets created by chewing; in the nose, various smells are accepted; in this way, this guna of that atma has been divided and separated up into sense organs.7

owis.original: वायोपंचकीं अंतःकर्णपंचक । मिसळोनि फिरे निशंक । ज्ञानइंद्रियें कर्मइंद्रियें सकळिक । सावकास पाहे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरणपंचक प्राणपंचकांत मिसळतें आणि निःशंकपणें शरीरांत वावरते. ज्ञानेंद्रियें व कर्मेंद्रियें यांचीं कार्ये सगळी अशा रीतेेनें स्वस्थपणें पाहावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this knowing of the `all' became the *five-fold antah-karana mixed together with the five vital winds/pranas and a gross body started to boldly wander around. Then this `all' sees by these five sensory organs and moves by these five organs of action. *(Knowing, mind, buddhi, thinking and ego; these met the five pranas and together these brought body consciousness and then mind says, "What is this?" and the buddhi gives it a name and the ego appears and says, "I want it" and the legs make the body to move towards it etc. Then effortless knowing has been left behind and the one wind that moves all creation gets confined to an individual body in the prana)

owis.original: कर्मइंद्रियें लागवेगीं । जीव भोगी विषयांलागीं । ऐसा हा उपाये जगीं । ईश्र्वरें केला ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या कर्मेंद्रियांद्वारा जीव विषय भोगतो. ईश्र्वरानें जगांत हा असा उपाय करुन ठेवला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to these organs of action the jiva moves hastily and enjoys the sense objects. Yet this remedy of the `all' (prakruti) created by ishwara (purush) is always there within this world created by the senses. (The experiences in this mundane existence cannot appear without this `all' experience. But upon this `all', the world has appeared and one feels, "I cannot live without a body")

owis.original: विषय निर्माण जाले बरवे । शरीरेंविण कैसे भोगावे । नाना शरीराचे गोवे । याकारणें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भोगण्याचे विषय पुष्कळ उत्पन्न केलेलें आहेत. पण तें शरीरावांचून भोगता येत नाहींत. म्हणून नानाप्रकारची गुंतागुंतीची शरीरें ईश्र्वरानें निर्माण केलीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The sense objects have been well made, but without the `all' body (knowledge) how can they be enjoyed? But on account of this knowing, there has come the `many' entanglements for this `all' body (so this knowing is detrimental when it looks down and creates the gross objects and it is the remedy also when it looks towards its source, that pure atma).

owis.original: अस्तीमांशाचें शरीर । त्यामधें गुणप्रकार । शरीरासारिखें यंत्र । आणीक नाहीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर हाडामांसाचे बनलेलें असतें. त्यामध्यें गुणांचे अनेक प्रकार असतात. या शरीरासारखें दुसरे यंत्र जगांत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `all' body is a body of bones and flesh and in that atma there has appeared the gunas of sattwa, raja and tamo. Really, there is no other instrument that can be compared to this `all' body that just knows (therefore understand it).

owis.original: ऐसीं शरीरें निर्माण केलीं । विषयभोगें वाढविलीं । लाहानथोर निर्माण जालीं । येणें प्रकारें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही शरीरें निर्माण केलीं. विषयांच्या भोगानें ती वाढविली. या रीतीनें त्यांच्यामधें लहान मोठा हा भेद निर्माण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, due to this `all' body, the separate gunas were created and from these the elements appeared and gross objectification took place. Therefore due to this `all' body, the sense objects and their enjoyment grew. And in this way, the small jiva within that great brahman was created.

owis.original: अस्तिमांशाचीं शरीरें । निर्माण केली जगदेश्र्वरें । विवेकें गुणविचारे । करुनियां ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगदीश्र्वरानें ही अस्थिमांसाची शरीरें निर्माण केलीं. ती निर्माण करतांना विवेकानें गुणविचार करुन त्यांना निर्माण केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: So, by means of this `all' body, that Lord of the world created the bodies of bo- nes and flesh. But if this `all' body makes vivek then, there will be the making of thoughtlessness.

owis.original: अस्तिमौंशाचा पुतळा । जेणें ज्ञानें सकळ कळा । शरीरभेद वेगळा । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर म्हणजे अस्थिमांसाचा पुतळा असतो. पण त्यांत ज्ञान भरलेलें आहे. त्याच्या सामर्थ्यानें जीवाला सर्व कला साध्य होतात. परंतु ठिकठिकाणीं शरीरांच्यामधें भेद आढलतो.
owis.englishMeaning: With this statue of flesh and bones, one can understand this art of the knowing but, when this `all' body gets divided then, there is a different body at every place.

owis.original: तो भेद कार्याकारण । त्याचा उदंड आहे गुण । सकळ तीक्ष्ण बुद्धीविण । कये कळे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या शरीरांत जेवढें ज्ञान असते, तेवढ्या कला त्यास साध्य होतात. शरीरांच्या ठिकाणीं हा जो भेद आढळतो त्याला देखील योग्य कारण आहे. त्या त्या भेदाचा मोठा उपयोग असतो. त्याच्या योगानेंच सर्व व्यवहार चालतात. पण तीक्ष्ण बुद्धिवांचून हें ध्यानांत येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that paramatma gets divided then, there is the brahmanda as the cause and the pinda as the effect and then, that vast nirgun paramatma is the gunas of *these two. How can this `all' be understood without a sharp and keen buddhi? *(Then there are the three gunas mixed together and an individual body is seen within this world/brahmanda)

owis.original: सकळ करणें ईश्र्वराला । म्हणोनी भेद निर्माण केला । ऊर्ध्वमुख होतां भेदाला । ठाव कैंचा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ईश्र्वराला हे विचित्र विश्र्व निर्माण करायचे होतें. म्हणून त्यानें भेद निर्माण केला. ऊर्ध्वमुख होऊन पाहिलें तर भेदाला जागाच राहात नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: To ishwara there is this action of the `all' and therefore these other divisions got created (ie. at the root there is the division of purush/prakruti and this only expanded into the `many' divisions). But if one `looks upwards' (maintains vivek of knowing and grows so big that one doesn't remain), then at the place of that One, how can there be division?

owis.original: सृष्टिकर्णी आगत्य भेद । संव्हारें सहजचि अभेद । भेद अभेद हा संवाद । मायागुणें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही सृष्टि निर्माण करायची म्हणजे, भेद अवश्यकच होता. सृष्टीचा संहार केला कीं तेथें सहजच अभेद असतो. माया आहे तोपर्यंत भेद  व अभेद ही भाषा संभवते.
owis.englishMeaning: The doings of the gross world are extremely diverse and by the destruction of these, there is that undivided and natural Self. Know that, the divided gossip and this undivided dialogue between the guru and disciple (ie. thoughtless) are both due to this sattwa guna of maya (where will you place your faith?).

owis.original: मायेमधें अंतरात्मा । नकळे तयाचा महिमा । जाला चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा । तोहि संदेहीं पडे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळमायेंत अंतरात्मा आहे. त्याचा महिमा कळत नाहीं. ब्रह्मदेवाला चार तोंडें असूनदेखील अंतरात्मा त्याला संशयांत पाडतो. मानवी बुद्धीला तर अनेक प्रश्र्ण पडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when there is this antar-atma in maya then, the greatness of the Reality is not understood. And when there is lord brahma (ie. buddhi) with his *four faces then, that paramatma falls into body consciousness. *(Four sources of birth)

owis.original: पीळ पेंच कडोविकडीं । तर्क तीक्ष्ण घडीनें घडी । मनासी होये तांतडी । विवरण करितां ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतरात्म्याचा विचार करतांना पदोपदी तर्काचे अनेक प्रकार, पीळ, पेंच, तीक्ष्ण तर्क वापरुन देखील अमतरात्म्याच अंत लागत नाहीं. त्यावेळीं मानवी मन अगदी हतबल होऊन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Either there can be `many' tricks, schemes and longings, or, each and every mo- ment, there can be the keenness of logic and the mind is encouraged to make proper investigation.

owis.original: आत्मत्वें लागतें सकळ कांहीं । निरंजनीं हे कांहींच नाहीं । येकांतकाळीं समजोन पाहीं । म्हणिजे बरें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याचा विचार करतांना या सगळ्या गोष्टी लागतात. पण निरंजन व निर्गुण परब्रह्माच्या ठिकाणीं यांचा कांहींच उपयोग होत नाही. एकांतांत जाऊन विचार केला तरच हें सगळें ध्यानांत येते.
owis.englishMeaning: By being that antar-atma there is the connection with this `all thing', but in that thoughtless niranjan there is no such `thing'. And in this time of `aloneness', one comes to understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: देहेसामर्थ्यानुसार । सकळ करी जगदेश्र्वर । थोर सामर्थ्यें अवतार । बोलिजेती ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें सर्व देहांमध्यें अंतरात्मा विभागलेला आही. प्रत्येकामध्यें त्याचा अंश आहे. ज्या देहाचें सामर्थ्य जेवढे असते तेवढेंच कार्य जगदीश्र्वर त्या देहाकडून करवून घेतो. ज्या देहामध्यें अतिशय थोर सामर्थ्य आढळतें त्यास अवतार असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the gross body merges in the power then, there is this `all' and that Lord of the world is called the doer. But due to this power, that great brahman has come down into knowledge. (Then that brahman is in maya and assumes the many different roles; Knower, knowing and known, doer, great elements, gross elements, gross body and mind and ego etc.)

owis.original: शेष कूर्म वर्‍हाव जाले । येवढे देहे विशाळ धरिले । तेणें करितां रचना चाले । सकळ सृष्टीची ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेष, कूर्म, वराह यांचे देह फारच विशाल आहेत. त्यांच्या आधारावर सारी सृष्टि चालते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the great serpent/shesh* (ie. purush) and the divine tortoise or the great boar (ie. prakruti). Then due to this prakruti and purush, that vast paramatma holds the various bodies. Thus on account of that Reality, there is this `all' and then from this there comes the construction of a gross world. *(That which remains when everything/thought is left off)

owis.original: ईश्र्वरें केवढें सूजगात्र केलें । सूर्यबिंब धावाया लाविलें । धुकटाकरवीं धरविलें । अगाध पाणी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ईश्वराने केवढी करामत केली आहे. त्यानें सूर्याला आकाशंत धावावयास लावलें आहे.ढग म्हणजे धूर. पण त्याच्यामधें उदंड पाणी साठवलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: So great is this mystery of ishwara (ie. purush). Due to Him, the sun is compelled to run through the sky and the clouds are capable of holding so much water in the emptiness above (see 16.2, the Sun is a metaphor for that eternal pure knowledge. When He is made to transverse the sky then, when He rises, He reveals this world and when He sets this world disappears. This is knowledge. When you awake, the world appears and when you sleep, the world goes off. But He always is there. And the clouds are a metaphor for ignorance. And they cause the rains of karma to fall down from the emptiness above, onto your head).

owis.original: पर्वताऐसे ढग उचलती । सूर्यबिंबासी आछ्यादिती । तेथें सवेंचि वायोची गती । प्रगट होये ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशामध्यें पर्वतप्राय ढग उत्पन्न होऊन सूर्याला झांकून टाकतात. मग तेथें वायूची गति लगेच प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Clouds (ie. maya) as big as mountains rise in the sky and cover that Sun with concepts. But when the winds of knowledge blow then, that Sun `there' is revealed.

owis.original: झिडकझिडकुं धांवे वारा । जैसा काळाचा म्हणियारा । ढग मारुनी दिनकरा । मोकळे करी ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जणूं कांहीं काळाच्या सेवकाप्रमाणें वारा झडझडून वाहूं लागतो. तो ढगाला मारुन टाकतो व सूर्याला मोकळे करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this wind of vivek blows forcefully then, it is like a messenger of death (ie. it heralds the death of `I am') and it destroys the clouds and frees the Sun (that thoughtless nirgun).

owis.original: बैसती वीजांचे तडाखे । प्राणीमात्र अवचिता धाके । गगन कडकडून तडके । स्थळांवरी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशामध्यें मग विजांचा गडगडांट सुरु होतो. प्राण्यांच्या मनांत त्यामुळें भय निर्माण होते. आणि आकाश कडाडून पृथ्वीवर आदळल्यासारखें वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the continuous flashing of lightning then, that one in only the prana, is this wonder and awe of knowledge (lightning is a metaphor for the mind. In the dark clouds of ignorance, it flashed to reveal an object in the darknesss. Now, it flashes to reveal this `all' and it thunders, `I am He', `I am He'). And afterwards, this sky (ie. space) comes crashing down (and even witnessing does not remain).

owis.original: येहलोकासी येक वर्म केलें । महद्भूते महद्भूतआळिलें । सकळां समभागें चालिलें । सृष्टिरचनेसी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या दृश्य विश्र्वामधें ईश्र्वरानें असें एक वर्म ठेवले आहे कीं, एक महाभूत दुसर्‍या महाभूतस आवरतें. म्हणून सर्व महाभूतांच्या सम प्रमाणानें सृष्टीचा व्यवहार व्यवस्थितपणें  चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: This world has been made out of that One essence and each great element `thickened' due to the next great element. In this way, this evenly distributed `all' has brought about the construction of a gross world.

owis.original: ऐसे अनंत भेद आत्मयाचे । सकळ जाणती ऐसे कैचें । विवरतां विवरतां मनाचे । फडके होती ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याचे अशा प्रकारें अनंत भेद आहेत. ते सगळे भेद जाणणारा कोणीच नाहीं. त्या भेदांचें विवरण करतां करतां मानवी मनाच्या चिंध्या होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: And when that endless paramatma has become the `many' divisions of the antar- atma then, how can there be this `all' and that Knower? But if there is a constant investigation of the mind then, this mind will be torn and shredded to pieces (lord krishna- mind is your bondage and your liberation).

owis.original: ऐसी माझी उपासना । उपासकीं आणावी मना । अगाध महिमा चतुरानना । काये कळे ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माझी उपासना ही अशी आहे. जे उपासक असतील त्यांनी तिच्यावर विचार करवा. त्या उपासनेचा महिमा प्रत्यक्ष ब्रह्मदेवाला देखील कळणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is my worship. Your mind should bring such a worshipper. But how can lord brahma understand the unfathomable greatness of that paramatma? (How can a small jiva understand That?)

owis.original: आवाहन विसर्जन । हें चि भजनाचें लक्षण । सकळ जाणती सज्जन । मी काये सांगों ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आवाहन आणि विसर्जन हेंच भजनाचें लश्रण आहे. संत सज्जन हें जाणतात. मी अधिक सांगण्याची गरज नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: First there has to be the *invocation of God (the witness of this knowledge `I am') and then the relinquishment of that God (I do not exist/vignyan). When knowledge has been relinquished then, there is that thoughtless bhajan. Then that Knower of this `all' becomes the sajjana/Saint and what then can this `I' say? *(The invocation and releasing/submersion of a god is a common practice of ritual worship; here the inner meaning is explained) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sukshma Nirupan (A Discourse on the Subtle)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मृतिकापूजन करावें । आणी सवेंचि विसर्जावें । हें मानेना स्वभावें । अंतःकर्णासी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मातीचा देव आणून त्याची पूजा करायची नंतर विसर्जन म्हणून त्यालाच टाकून द्यायचा. हें आपल्या अंतःकरणाला स्वाभाविकपणें योग्य वाटत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If one makes puja to a clay idol and then promptly immerses that idol in water then, that thoughtless swarup can never be accepted by your antah-karana (if you continue idol worship, how can you ever know your Self? maharaj- they go to a stone and they ask for something and miraculous things happen. But they don't understand; that power had come from themselves)

owis.original: देव पूजावा आणी टाकावा । हें प्रशस्त न वटे जीवा । याचा विचार पाहावा । अंतर्यामीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या देवाची पूजा करयची त्यालाच टाकून द्यायचा. हें माणसाच्या जीवाला प्रशस्त वाटत नाहीं. आपल्या मनांत याचा विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If God is worshipped and then thrown away then, that most praiseworthy, thoughtless swarup can never appear and there is a jiva (if you act like a jiva and remain like a jiva then, how can you be that formless swarup?). Therefore that thoughtlessness (nirgun) of this `speech' (sagun) should be understood within.

owis.original: देव करिजे ऐसा नाहीं । देव टाकिजे ऐसा नाहीं । म्हणोनि याचा कांहीं । विचार पाहावा ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव बनवतां येण्यासारखा नाहीं. तसाच तो टाकून देण्यासारखा पण नाहीं. म्हणून यावर कांहीं विचार करणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: God cannot be made and God cannot be thrown away like this. Therefore you should understand this `thing' and thoughtlessness.

owis.original: देव नाना शरिरें धरितो । धरुनी मागुती सोडितो । तरी तो देव कैसा आहे तो । विवेकें वोळखावा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव अनेक देह धारण करतो. आणि धरल्यानंतर मागून तें टाकून देतो. देह धारण करणारा आणि देह सोडणारा हा देव कसा आहे, ते विवेकानें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: God upholds the `many' bodies with His `all' body and after holding them for some time, He leaves. Still who is that God? By vivek that atma should be recognized.

owis.original: नाना साधनें निरुपणें । देव शोधायाकारणें । सकळ आपुले अंतःकर्णे । समजले पाहिजे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचा शोध कसा करावा हे सांगणारीं अनेक निरुपणें आहेत. तशीच अनेक साधनेंही आहेत. पण ती सगळी आपण आपल्या अंतःकरणानें समजून घेतली पाहिजेत.
owis.englishMeaning: In order to search for God there are the `many' sadhanas and `many' discourses. But your antah-karana should understood this `all'.

owis.original: ब्रह्मज्ञानाचा उपाये । समजल्याविण देतां नये । पदार्थ आहे मा घे जाये । ऐसें म्हणावें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मज्ञानाचा उपाय स्वतः समजून घ्यावा. तो स्वतःला समजल्यावांचून दुसरा कोणी देऊं शकत नाही. तो कांहीं असा पदार्थ नाहीं कीं, '" हा घेऊन जा "असें म्हणतां येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Without understanding this remedy of knowing, that pure knowledge of brahman cannot be accepted. This `object' is present here and now, but one should accept it and then only say, "Now take it away" (first understand this `object' of knowing ie. invocation of God, and then immerse it in thoughtlessness).

owis.original: सगट लोकांचे अंतरींचा भाव । मज प्रतक्ष भेटवावा देव । परंतु विवेकाचा उपाव । वेगळाचि आहे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वसाधारण माणसाच्या मनांत असा हेतु असतो कीं, " मला देवाची प्रत्यक्ष भेट व्हावी " परंतु देवदर्शन करुन घेण्यास विवेकाचा उपाय कांहीं वेगळाच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if in your inner space there is this understanding of a lumped together gross world, then you will feel, "My eyes should see God." However this remedy of vivek is quite different (the viveki understands, "My sense organs and my intellect cannot know Him").

owis.original: विचार पाहातां तगेना । त्यास देव ऐसें म्हणावेना । परंतु जन राहेना । काये करावें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विचारानें परीक्षण केलें असतां, जें शाश्वतपणें टिकत नाहीं त्यास देव म्हणता येत नाहीं. पण लोक ऐकत नाहींत ते अशाश्वतालाच देव म्हणतात. याला कांहीं इलाज नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And even if you understand thoughtlessness but do not maintain it then, that un- derstanding cannot be called God. But the people do not stop thinking, so what to do! (Unless the mind is stopped one will continue as a body and continue to do `many' forms of worship and sadhana)

owis.original: थोर लोक मरोनि जाती । त्यांच्या सुरता करुनी पाहाती । तैसीच आहे हेहि गती । उपासनेची ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थोर माणसें मरुन गेल्यावर त्यांच्या मूर्ति करुन ठेवतात. व ती मूर्ति तो माणूस आहे असें समजतात. उपासनेच्या बाबतींत असाच प्रकार होतो. आपल्या कल्पनेनें देवाची मूर्ति करुन त्यासच सामान्य लोक देव समजतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That One has destroyed brahman and this world of the `all' (by body consciousness). Therefore now, that One is to make and understand this `all' form of that brahman. Truly everything is in your hands. For whatever worship that thoughtless Self makes, that It will gain (if you take yourself to be a jiva and make the worships that jiva make then, you will keep this body. But if you worship that thoughtless by being thoughtless then, you will gain Yourself).

owis.original: थोर व्यापार ठाकेना जनीं । म्हणोनि केली रखतवानी । राजसंपदा तयाचेनी । प्राप्त कैची ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या माणसाला मोठा व्यापार करणें जमेना, म्हणून त्यानें शाईचा व्यापार केला. तर त्या व्यापारांत त्याला राजासारखी संपत्ती मिळवणें कधींच शक्य नाही. उपासनेला हाच नियम लागूं आहे. खरा देव साध्य होत नाहीं म्हणून मातीच्या मूर्तिची उपासना करण्यानें खरें समाधान प्राप्त होणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The people do not know this pervasiveness of brahman and so they continue to perform some job for some remittance. How can they acquire the wealth of that King, when they continually take themselves to be a jiva?

owis.original: म्हणोनि जितुका भोळाभाव । तितुका अज्ञानाचा स्वभाव । अज्ञानें तरी देवाधिदेव । पाविजेल कैचा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून जेवढा भोळा भाव आहे तेवढा अज्ञानाचा स्वभाव समजावा. अज्ञानानें परमात्मस्वरुपाची प्राप्ती होणें शक्य नाहीं. दृश्य मिथ्या आहे. तें खरें मानणें हाच अज्ञानस्वभाव आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the blind faith of a jiva then, this effortless and spontaneous `all' is full of ignorance. But how can that God of the gods be realized through such ignorance?

owis.original: अज्ञानासी ज्ञान न माने । ज्ञात्यास अनुमान न माने । म्हणोनि सिद्धांचीये खुणें । पावलें पाहिजे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अज्ञानी माणसाला ज्ञान मानवत नाहीं. तर ज्ञानी माणसाला केवळ तर्कवाद मानवत नाहीं. म्हणून जे साक्षात्कारी सिद्ध आहेत त्यांचे अनुभव प्रमाण धरुन त्यांच्या संकेतांनी आपण वागलें पाहिजे. आपले अनुभव संतांच्या अनुभवाशी जुळले पाहिजेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Ignorance does not respect knowledge. And the Knower does not respect conjecture. Therefore He should acquire that pure nirgun understanding of the siddha (by dropping all conjecture and remaining with the conviction of the Knower).

owis.original: माया सांडून मुळास जावें । तरीच समाधान पावावें । ऐसें न होतां भरंगळावें । भलतीकडे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया बाजूस टाकून मूळ परब्रह्मापर्यंत गेल्यावर खरें समाधान लाभतें. असें झालें नाहीं तर साधक भलतीकडेच भरकटतो. त्याला समाधान लाभत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: One should go to the root of maya and then leave her aside. Then only will there be complete contentment. If this is not done then, that `fullness of being' will be wasted away on irrelevant things.

owis.original: माया उलंघावाकारणें । देवासी नाना उपाय करणें । अध्यात्मश्रवणपंथेंचि जाणे । प्रत्ययानें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मायेचे उल्लंघन करतां यावें म्हणून भगवंतानें साधनेचे अनेक प्रकार निर्माण करुन ठेवलें आहेत. परंतु त्या सर्व प्रकारांत अध्यात्माचें श्रवणमनन ही सर्व श्रेष्ठ साधना आहे. साधकानें तसें करुन स्वतः अनुभव घेत पुढें जावें.
owis.englishMeaning: And even if, in order to cross over this maya, the mind performs this remedy of shravan still, that nirgun is knowing this path of shravan (shravan is the remedy but one has to understand it is not the nirgun and He is being made to perform shravan).

owis.original: ऐसें न करितां लोकिकीं । अवघीच होते चुकामुकी । स्थिति खरी आणि लटकी । ऐसी वोळखावी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या राजमार्गानें न जातां सामान्य माणसें अन्य उपाय करतात. त्यामुळे त्यांची व देवाची चुकामुक होते. साधना खरी कोणती व खोटी कोणती अशा रीतीनें ओळखावीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But if shravan is not made in this world then, one losses one's Self in the `many' actions. Therefore one should recognize that state that is true and the states that are false.

owis.original: खोट्याचे वाटे जाऊं नये । खोट्याची संगती धरुं नये । खोटें संग्रहीं करुं नये । कांहींयेक ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें मिथ्या आहे त्याच्या वाटेनें जाऊं नये. त्याची संगत धरुं नये. कांहीहि मिथ्या संग्रही ठेवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not walk the path of the false. One should not keep company with the false. One should not hoard anything that is false.
owis.note: John Norwell's English translation is truncated to a single stray letter ('v') for this owi, cut off right before a page break in the source PDF with no continuation afterward. The English above is a direct rendering of the sourced Marathi meaning rather than an independently cross-checked translation.

owis.original: खोटें तें खोटेंचि खोटें । खर्‍यासीं तगेनात बालटें । मन अधोमुख उफराटें । केलें पाहिजे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें मिथ्या आहे तें कोणत्याहि कालीं कोणत्याहि परिस्थितींत मिथ्याच राहणार हें खरें आहे. त्याच्यापुढें खोट्याचा टिकाव लागत नाहीं. खोट्यामधें गुंतलेले मन खर्‍याकडे नेण्यासाठीं त्यास उरफाटे केलें पाहिजे. बहिर्मुख मनाला अंतर्मुख केलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality gets made false by the false, but with the Truth, the fraudulent cannot remain. Therefore your mind which is looking outwards should turn around and look inwards.

owis.original: अध्यात्मश्रवण करीत जावें । म्हणिजे सकळ कांहीं फावे । नाना प्रकारीचे गोवे । तुटोनी जाती ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अध्यात्म श्रवण करीत जावें. त्या योगानें सर्व गोष्टी हस्तगत होतात. अनेक प्रकारच्या गुंतागुंती उकलल्या जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be shravan and when this `all thing' is acquired then, the entangle- ments of the ways of the `many' will be cut.

owis.original: सूत गुंतलें तें उकलावें । तैसे मन उगवावें । मानत मानत घालावें । मुळाकडे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणें सुताचा गुंता आपण उकलतो. त्याचप्रमाणें मनाचा झालेला गुंता उकलावा. मनाला हळूहळू मूळ परब्रह्माकडे वळवावे. मायेच्या पसार्‍यांत अनेक ठिकाणीं अनेक प्रकारें गुंतलेले मन क्रमाक्रमानें तेथून सोडवावे. त्यास अंतर्मुख करुन परब्रह्माकडे वाटचाल करण्याची हळुंहळुं सवय लावावी.
